div.div:
Contract for your register block
• Honour wr_strb byte by byte.
• wr_addr_valid / rd_addr_valid = 0 → the shell answers SLVERR.
• rd_data must be combinational from rd_addr. AW and W may arrive in any order.
• wr_data / wr_strb are the full 256-bit beat; rd_data is the full 32-byte line. Used for the Boot ROM and SRAM front ends.
